note: Tunable numbers for the Quora feed scan. Edit these values to change scan behavior — the scan job reads this file fresh on every run, so changes apply to the next run with nothing to restart. Do NOT edit the cron .md file directly: it is a read-only copy and changes there have no effect. block_cap_suspended=true: block cap suspended for the next scan round only (set 2026-09-30) — re-enable (false) when that round completes. assessment_only_mode=true: profile evaluation classifies Red/Yellow/Green and files in lists, with no follower collection or sweeps.
